messages:
Sabrina James: Kicking off parity pass on quickstarts/snippets across Python/TS/Go before we merge the checklist docs + “production readiness” quickstart. Goal: same step order + same recommended defaults (timeouts/retries/streaming). Can folks drop where you’re at + anything blocking?

Wei Chen: +1. For docs we’re trying to keep the checklist step links consistent across languages. If we don’t align now we’ll ship mismatched guidance and Support will get wrecked. :grimacing:

Monica Patel: Yep, let’s lock “prod-safe defaults” and snippet content this week. Also reminder: anything we change in SDK defaults needs to be explicitly called out in changelog + quickstart text.

Ibrahim Khan: I can propose the cross-lang standard today. We should pick:
- default request timeout
- retry policy (which status codes; backoff; max attempts)
- streaming reconnect story (or explicitly “don’t auto-replay unless idempotent”)
We should NOT pretend all languages can do identical streaming semantics.

Dana Lo: TS side: PR #804 (snippet generator + streaming helper) is almost ready. We can mirror the checklist steps in the generated snippet: API key env var, create client, basic chat completion, then streaming, then retries/timeouts.

Mateusz Zielinski: Go side: PR #412 is in review for streaming reconnect helper. But I want to be careful w/ reconnect defaults. We can provide a helper that callers opt into + doc the gotchas.

Sabrina James: Awesome. For parity, can we agree on the order + minimal set of “recommended defaults” shown in quickstarts?
I’m thinking:
1) Set `REDWOOD_API_KEY` + endpoint
2) First non-streaming request
3) Turn on streaming
4) Production safety: timeouts + retries/backoff + request id
5) Observability hook (request id + basic logging)
6) Quotas/budgets pointers (Console link)

Wei Chen: That matches the checklist template we’ve been using. Also we need to keep the naming consistent: “timeouts + retries” not “resilience” etc.

Ibrahim Khan: Proposed defaults (cross-lang, where supported):
- Timeout: 30s overall for non-streaming; for streaming, no fixed overall but set read timeout / keepalive and surface “disconnect handling”.
- Retries: up to 2 retries (3 attempts total) on 429/503/504 + network errors, exponential backoff w/ jitter (e.g., 250ms base, max 2s), respect `Retry-After`.
- Do NOT retry on 4xx (except 429). Do NOT retry streaming mid-response.
- Always attach a `X-Request-Id` (or SDK equivalent) and log it.

Monica Patel: +1 on those. Also for first success (TTFS) we need snippet to make it easy: minimal code, minimal dependencies.

Dana Lo: TS generator can do:
```ts
import { Redwood } from "@redwood-inference/sdk";

const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY!,
  timeoutMs: 30_000,
  retry: { maxAttempts: 3 },
});
```
We have a `client.chat.completions.create()` example + `stream: true` example.
Question: do we standardize env var name? some older docs say `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN`.

Elliot Price: Docs decision: canonical is `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. We’re adding redirects + calling out legacy var name as “supported but deprecated” (don’t show in snippets). Please update any quickstart templates if they mention token.

Mateusz Zielinski: Go quickstart currently shows `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` in README :facepalm:. I’ll swap.

Sabrina James: Great catch. I’ll do a sweep in examples repo too.

Wei Chen: Also: base URL. Some snippets show `https://api.redwood.com/v1` vs `https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1` (old). Which is right?

Monica Patel: Use `https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1` everywhere. (Alias exists but marketing doesn’t want it in docs.)

Ibrahim Khan: On streaming: we should add one standard paragraph across languages explaining:
- streaming responses can disconnect; client should be able to resume *by reissuing the request* but output may differ
- for “production launch”, use server-side timeouts + retry for initial connect; do not replay partial generations unless app-level idempotency

Dana Lo: TS helper will include an example of handling `AbortController` + reconnect only before first token.

Mateusz Zielinski: Go helper is “connect with retry” only. Once bytes start, we don’t auto-reconnect.

Sabrina James: For Python: do we have the preset defaults merged yet?

Monica Patel: Python PR #1183 is approved pending final naming on preset. It adds `client = Redwood(timeout=..., max_retries=...)` and a `ProductionPreset`. Monica (me) will merge once Ibrahim signs off on retry behavior.

Ibrahim Khan: I’ll review the Python PR today. Main ask: ensure we respect `Retry-After` for 429 and we don’t retry on auth errors.

Wei Chen: Checklist step “Handle 429s + set quotas” needs consistent language. We should link to the Console quotas page + show a tiny backoff snippet. But avoid teaching people to hammer.

Jean-Paul Laurent: +1. Copy wise: we should keep the quickstart short and point to “Production readiness” doc for full policy. But include enough so people don’t ship `while(true) retry`.

Sabrina James: Action items I’m capturing:
- Dana: confirm TS generator uses `REDWOOD_API_KEY` + canonical base URL; align retry defaults w/ Ibrahim.
- Mateusz: update Go quickstart/env var + ensure helper docs match “no mid-stream retries”.
- Monica/Ibrahim: merge Python preset PR after review.
- Wei/Elliot: update docs pages to only show `REDWOOD_API_KEY` + base URL; add note for legacy vars.
- Me: sweep examples repo + quickstarts repo for env var/base URL; make sure step order matches checklist.

Connor O'Brien: Timing: if we want to include this in cohort rollout, we need docs + quickstarts merged by EOW Wed (for release notes cut). Can we get PRs ready by Tuesday?

Dana Lo: TS PR can be ready today. Will post link here.

Mateusz Zielinski: Go changes tomorrow morning PT.

Monica Patel: Python merge tomorrow pending review.

Redwood CI Bot: buildkite: redwood-sdk-typescript pipeline #22819 passed (unit + lint). Artifact: `snippets-preview.zip`

Sabrina James: Thanks. One more nit: model name in examples. We should pick one recommended “starter model” and keep it consistent across languages, otherwise folks will copy/paste different things and compare perf weirdly.

Wei Chen: docs currently use `redwood/llama-3.1-8b-instruct` in quickstart. ok to standardize there?

Monica Patel: Works. Just make sure it exists in catalog in all regions for Hosted.

Ibrahim Khan: Also: include “pin model version for prod” step, but don’t add complexity to first call. Maybe a short note: “Once you go to prod, pin `model: ...@2025-02-xx`” with link.

Jean-Paul Laurent: We can add a callout box in the “production readiness” quickstart, not in the hello-world.

Sabrina James: Perfect. I’ll keep hello-world minimal, and production quickstart mirrors checklist.

Dana Lo: Posting TS PR: https://github.com/redwood/redwood-sdk-typescript/pull/804
Open questions in PR description: retries on DNS errors? I set network errors = retryable.

Ibrahim Khan: Network errors retryable is fine as long as we cap attempts + jitter. I’ll comment in PR.

Mateusz Zielinski: Go PR for env var + base URL sweep will be in redwood-quickstarts, not sdk. I’ll drop link when up.

Elliot Price: When you update READMEs, please keep the docs URLs consistent w/ new IA. Use `/docs/onboarding/checklist` as anchor; older `/docs/quickstart` will redirect but don’t keep linking it.

Sabrina James: Noted. I’ll update links in examples + quickstarts.

Connor O'Brien: Once PRs merge, ping me and I’ll sync w/ Soojin on release notes wording (we shouldn’t claim “auto-reconnect streaming” if only TS has helper).

Sabrina James: :thumbsup: Will do.
